header: One bar per item, on one shared scale
lead: Each bar's width is the number typed on its row, as a percentage of the plot. Scale the values yourself and name the scale in the caption.
caption: The caption names the scale, so readers can compare the lengths
note: Below 640px each bar moves to its own line. On a phone, three columns would leave the bar too narrow to read.

metrics.title: The top of the scale
metrics.text: Values above 100 stop at the full width.

metrics.title: Another row
metrics.text: A row left empty reads as zero, never as full.
